src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: U.S. Census Bureau, 2010 Census Apportionment Results
Alaska has one seat (at large) in every year here. The Census file draws the whole state as one at-large district (code 00).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2013 Proclamation Plan (20 Senate districts, letters A to T)
Alaska Division of Elections, District Maps page: archive of the redistricting plan according to the July 14, 2013 Proclamation Plan

The Board's first plan (2011-12) was rejected by the Alaska Supreme Court in Dec 2012; the Board's July 2013 plan was used 2014 through 2020. Census cb_2020 files hold the plans the Bureau collected for the 2018 election (116th Congress, 2018 legislative districts, per its user note); this state did not change them before the 2020 election.
